results.title: Superseding every unread document with a text note
results.evidence: superseding an unread PDF with a 31-byte text note moved coverage from 0.0 to 1.0 (1 unread → 0) while the content it measured became unreachable: a term inside the superseded document now returns 0 result(s). The figure a reader is told to check before trusting an empty answer is improved by removing the documents it was counting
